author: BoldAndBrash
body:
Pretty much, all of you have to do to win is go into water and tp someone to you and kill them. If you are in water, you are almost 100% invincible. You get hit around 3 times and regen in 2 seconds to full health.

Opinions?

replies.body: I can attest to this. I recently fought a Poseidon for 5 minutes and even almost broke a sword against them. This is made even more OP by the fact that poseidons pull you into the water with their fishing rods if you try to run.
